title: Zero-latency tapping: using hover information to predict touch locations and eliminate touchdown latency
summary: A method that uses hover information and a model of 3D finger movement to predict the direction, location and time of a touch before touchdown, reducing the apparent latency of touch input.

title: Tracs: transparency-control for see-through displays
summary: A dual-sided see-through display system with a controllable transparency layer, letting users switch fast between personal and collaborative work and avoid visual interference and privacy problems on transparent displays.

title: Through the combining glass
summary: A design space for planar reflective optical combiners that merge the spaces in front of and behind them, explored through three augmented reality prototypes that let multiple users interact via their reflections.

title: High rate, low-latency multi-touch sensing with simultaneous orthogonal multiplexing
summary: A projected capacitive multi-touch sensor that uses simultaneous orthogonal signals to reach a very high frame rate and very low touch-to-data latency, demonstrated with a high-speed DLP projector.

title: Skin buttons: cheap, small, low-powered and clickable fixed-icon laser projectors
summary: A technique using tiny fixed-icon laser projectors with infrared proximity sensors in a smartwatch to render touch-sensitive icons on the skin, expanding the interactive area around the device.

title: WirePrint: 3D printed previews for fast prototyping
summary: A rapid prototyping technique that prints low-fidelity wireframe previews on standard FDM 3D printers by extruding filament directly into 3D space, letting designers iterate on designs much faster.

title: Loupe: a handheld near-eye display
summary: A handheld near-eye display device with a virtual display like head-up display glasses, with touch, motion and focal depth sensing for input and an interface for quick access to information feeds.

title: Vibkinesis: notification by direct tap and 'dying message' using vibronic movement controllable smartphones
summary: A smartphone that controls its own movement and rotation on a table using attached vibration motors, notifying users by tapping their hand or by changing its orientation, even after the battery is discharged.

title: Teegi: tangible EEG interface
summary: A tangible interface combining spatial augmented reality, tangible interaction and real-time neurotechnologies that lets novice users visualize and analyze their own EEG brain activity on a manipulable physical character.

title: Graffiti fur: turning your carpet into a computer display
summary: A display technology that uses the changing shading of fur fibers when raised or flattened, with three drawing devices that turn carpets and other fur objects into rewritable displays without modifying them.

title: In-air gestures around unmodified mobile devices
summary: A machine learning based algorithm using random forests and only the built-in RGB camera to recognize in-air gestures and fingertips around unmodified mobile devices, enabling touch plus gesture input on phones, tablets and smartwatches.

title: A series of tubes: adding interactivity to 3D prints using internal pipes
summary: A technique and design tool for rapidly prototyping interactive 3D printed objects by routing internal pipes through 3D models, which can be filled post-print with media for sensing, display and haptic feedback.

title: LightRing: always-available 2D input on any surface
summary: A wearable sensor in a ring form factor that tracks the 2d location of a fingertip on any surface, enabling always-available 2D input without instrumenting other body parts or the environment.

title: Physical telepresence: shape capture and display for embodied, computer-mediated remote collaboration
summary: An approach to physical telepresence for shared workspaces using shape capture and remote rendering on shape displays, with interaction techniques to manipulate remote physical objects and amplify users' capabilities in teleoperation.

title: Sensing techniques for tablet+stylus interaction
summary: Grip and motion sensing techniques, using a sensor-augmented stylus and tablet case, that detect how users hold pen and tablet to tailor pen + touch interaction, such as ignoring palm contact and invoking context-appropriate tools.

title: SideSwipe: detecting in-air gestures around mobile devices using actual GSM signal
summary: A system that detects in-air hand gestures above and around a mobile device by sensing the unmodified GSM signal with added receiving antennas, without line-of-sight or instrumenting the body.

title: Trampoline: a double-sided elastic touch device for creating reliefs
summary: A double-sided elastic touchpad that senses finger position and force on both sides, with a repoussé and chasing interaction technique for modeling reliefs on virtual surfaces.

title: RoomAlive: magical experiences enabled by scalable, adaptive projector-camera units
summary: A distributed system of projector-depth camera units that auto-calibrate to turn any room into an interactive projection mapping, augmented gaming experience where users touch, shoot and dodge content adapted to the room.

title: GaussStones: shielded magnetic tangibles for multi-token interactions on portable displays
summary: A system of magnetic tangibles shielded by galvanized steel cases, sensed by an analog Hall-sensor grid, that supports multi-token interactions on portable displays by eliminating interference between magnets.

title: Hover Pad: interacting with autonomous and self-actuated displays in space
summary: A crane-mounted prototype and toolkit for autonomous and self-actuated displays that move in space, with interaction techniques for exploring volumetric data sets hands-free instead of holding a handheld display.

title: FlatFitFab: interactive modeling with planar sections
summary: An interactive modeling system for planar section assemblies, with a single-stroke drawing workflow, procedural operations, and real-time physical simulation and geometric checks so users can fabricate stable, functional objects.

title: Air+touch: interweaving touch & in-air gestures
summary: A class of interactions that interweave touch events with in-air gestures, where touch designates targets and segments the gestures, letting people perform more expressive input on mobile devices.

title: 3D-board: a whole-body remote collaborative whiteboard
summary: A digital whiteboard for remote collaboration that captures life-sized 3D virtual embodiments of distributed users and blends them with the shared workspace, preserving awareness of full-body pose and gestures.

title: WristFlex: low-power gesture input with wrist-worn pressure sensors
summary: A wrist-worn, low-power gesture input device using an array of force sensitive resistors to classify subtle finger pinch gestures from tendon movements, offering an always-available on-body gestural interface.

title: Dyadic projected spatial augmented reality
summary: A room-scale spatial augmented reality system using projector camera pairs and depth cameras that supports dynamic projection mapping and separate perspective views, letting two face to face users interact with 3D virtual objects without devices.

title: Tag system with low-powered tag and depth sensing camera
summary: A tag system with small, low-power liquid crystal tags that send IDs through a retroreflector and are read by a depth sensing camera, giving wide readable range for ubiquitous computing applications.

title: FlexSense: a transparent self-sensing deformable surface
summary: A thin-film, transparent, self-sensing deformable surface with sparse printed piezoelectric sensors and algorithms that reconstruct complex 3D deformations in real-time, enabling flexible input such as a transparent tablet cover.

title: HaptoMime: mid-air haptic interaction with a floating virtual screen
summary: A mid-air interaction system that superposes hands-free ultrasonic tactile feedback on a floating virtual screen, letting users touch floating images and feel them.

title: Sensory triptych: here, near, out there
summary: A set of exploratory, interactive sensing toys and devices for children that reframe sensors to explore the soil, air, water, nearby places and orbiting satellites around them.

title: PrintScreen: fabricating highly customizable thin-film touch-displays
summary: An enabling technology for digital fabrication of customized flexible thin-film electroluminescent displays by screen or inkjet printing, with integrated touch sensing, letting non-experts rapidly print displays on varied substrates.

title: Brain-based target expansion
summary: A brain-computer interface technique using fNIRS to adaptively expand high-importance targets of the bubble cursor when multitasking is detected, improving pointing performance without visual changes.

title: ShrinkyCircuits: sketching, shrinking, and formgiving for electronic circuits
summary: A novel electronic prototyping technique that captures the flexibility of sketching and uses shrinking prestressed polymer film to make low-cost, miniature, planar and curved, multi-layer circuits in minutes.

title: Impacto: Simulating Physical Impact by Combining Tactile Stimulation with Electrical Muscle Stimulation
summary: A wearable device that simulates the haptic sensation of hitting and being hit in virtual reality by combining tactile stimulation from a solenoid with electrical muscle stimulation.

title: Self-Calibrating Head-Mounted Eye Trackers Using Egocentric Visual Saliency
summary: A method that automatically self-calibrates head-mounted eye trackers, video-based and Electrooculography-based, using a computational model of bottom-up visual saliency on the egocentric scene video, reducing calibration drift without manual calibration.

title: Anger-based BCI Using fNIRS Neurofeedback
summary: An active, fNIRS-based neurofeedback interface for affective Brain-Computer Interfaces that uses left-right prefrontal oxygenation asymmetry, driven by users expressing anger at a virtual character, as BCI input.

title: Candid Interaction: Revealing Hidden Mobile and Wearable Computing Activities
summary: A concept and design space of candid interaction, with prototypes that share mobile and wearable device activity with nearby people, supporting awareness and social acceptability of device use.

title: CyclopsRing: Enabling Whole-Hand and Context-Aware Interactions Through a Fisheye Ring
summary: A ring-style fisheye imaging wearable device worn on the hand webbing that recognizes whole-hand gestures and sees environmental context, enabling finger, palm and in-air input for wearable devices.

title: ReForm: Integrating Physical and Digital Design through Bidirectional Fabrication
summary: A concept of bidirectional fabrication and a clay-based system combining additive and subtractive digital fabrication, 3D scanning and projected augmented reality so digital models and physical objects stay synchronized during design.

title: LineFORM: Actuated Curve Interfaces for Display, Interaction, and Constraint
summary: A design space and prototypes of actuated curve interfaces, a class of shape-changing interfaces built from a chain of servo motors that display shapes, sense deformation and touch, and constrain users' motion.

title: Kinetic Blocks: Actuated Constructive Assembly for Interaction and Display
summary: Techniques for actuated constructive assembly, in which a pin-based shape display assembles, disassembles and reassembles passive building blocks, plus unpowered kinematic blocks driven and sensed through the pins for interaction and display.

title: Looking through the Eye of the Mouse: A Simple Method for Measuring End-to-end Latency using an Optical Mouse
summary: A method for measuring end-to-end latency in graphical user interfaces by placing an unmodified optical mouse on the screen and displaying a particular texture that fakes mouse displacements, with probes inserted at system levels.

title: FlexiBend: Enabling Interactivity of Multi-Part, Deformable Fabrications Using Single Shape-Sensing Strip
summary: A thin, flexible shape-sensing strip built from a dense linear array of strain gauges that lets makers add interactivity to multi-part, deformable fabrications and capture their geometry.

title: Biometric Touch Sensing: Seamlessly Augmenting Each Touch with Continuous Authentication
summary: A technique and wrist-worn prototype that lets commodity touchscreens biometrically identify and continuously authenticate users on every touch, replacing password dialogs and integrating authentication into touch interaction.

title: BackHand: Sensing Hand Gestures via Back of the Hand
summary: A wearable hand gesture interface that senses tendon movement on the back of the hand with an array of strain gauge sensors and machine learning to recognize a variety of hand gestures.

title: TurkDeck: Physical Virtual Reality Based on People
summary: A prop-based virtual reality system that uses human actuators, guided by projected visual instructions, to place and operate generic props just in time so users can feel arbitrarily large virtual worlds in finite space.

title: PERCs: Persistently Trackable Tangibles on Capacitive Multi-Touch Displays
summary: Persistent capacitive tangibles that use a small field sensor to detect a touch screen's probing signal, so they know whether they are on a capacitive multi-touch display even when not touched.

title: Patching Physical Objects
summary: A system built on a 3D printer that patches an existing physical object by milling away outdated geometry and printing new geometry in place, reducing material and waste during design iteration.

title: Tactile Animation by Direct Manipulation of Grid Displays
summary: A tool and rendering pipeline for authoring tactile animations by directly manipulating phantom vibrotactile sensations, letting animators design spatiotemporal haptic patterns for sparse vibrotactile grid displays.

title: uniMorph: Fabricating Thin Film Composites for Shape-Changing Interfaces
summary: A rapid digital fabrication approach for thin-film shape-changing composites of copper flexible circuits and polyethylene, with integrated sensing, letting designers print custom shape-changing interfaces.

title: Tracko: Ad-hoc Mobile 3D Tracking Using Bluetooth Low Energy and Inaudible Signals for Cross-Device Interaction
summary: A relative 3D tracking system for commodity mobile devices that fuses Bluetooth low energy signal strength, inaudible stereo sounds and inertial sensors, enabling ad-hoc cross-device interaction without added components or calibration.

title: RevoMaker: Enabling Multi-directional and Functionally-embedded 3D printing using a Rotational Cuboidal Platform
summary: A self-contained 3D printer that modifies a standard FDM printer with a revolving laser-cut cuboidal platform, printing multi-directionally around pre-embedded functional components to reduce support material and produce functional prototypes.

title: Joint 5D Pen Input for Light Field Displays
summary: A light field display design that uses one lenslet array for both display and infrared pen sensing, recovering a pen's 3D position and 2D orientation to allow 4D interaction such as painting.

title: GazeProjector: Accurate Gaze Estimation and Seamless Gaze Interaction Across Multiple Displays
summary: A system that combines natural feature tracking of displays with a head-mounted eye tracker for accurate gaze estimation and seamless gaze interaction across multiple displays from arbitrary positions without re-calibration.

title: Tomo: Wearable, Low-Cost Electrical Impedance Tomography for Hand Gesture Recognition
summary: A wearable, low-cost system using Electrical Impedance Tomography with electrodes on a wrist- or armband to recover the interior of the arm and recognize hand gestures for smartwatch input.

title: EM-Sense: Touch Recognition of Uninstrumented, Electrical and Electromechanical Objects
summary: A sensing technique that uses a modified low-cost software-defined radio worn on the body to detect and classify electromagnetic noise, recognizing touched electrical and electromechanical objects without instrumenting them.

title: MoveableMaker: Facilitating the Design, Generation, and Assembly of Moveable Papercraft
summary: A software tool for designing, generating and assembling moveable papercraft, informed by a survey and taxonomy of moveables, that outputs cutting blueprints and assembly instructions for paper cutters and laser cutters.

title: 3D Printed Hair: Fused Deposition Modeling of Soft Strands, Fibers, and Bristles
summary: A technique for fabricating soft 3D printed hair, fibers and bristles on a commodity fused deposition modeling printer by exploiting stringing, with design parameters and post-processing techniques for controlling strand properties.

title: Corona: Positioning Adjacent Device with Asymmetric Bluetooth Low Energy RSSI Distributions
summary: A spatial sensing technique that implicitly locates adjacent mobile devices in the same plane by comparing Bluetooth Low Energy RSSI readings against asymmetric RSSI distribution models, enabling cross-device interactions.

title: Projectibles: Optimizing Surface Color For Projection
summary: Algorithms that split an input video sequence into a static printed image and a dynamic projected image, optimizing display surface color for video projection to increase contrast and resolution.

title: GelTouch: Localized Tactile Feedback Through Thin, Programmable Gel
summary: A thin, transparent tactile feedback layer of thermoresponsive hydrogel that selectively switches between soft and stiff, giving localized multi-touch tactile feedback on touch screens through three heat activation techniques.

title: SmartTokens: Embedding Motion and Grip Sensing in Small Tangible Objects
summary: A small, coin-sized tangible token platform embedding motion and grip sensing with wireless communication, supporting tangible user interfaces and sensor network user interfaces, illustrated by a tangible notification and task management interface.

title: HapticPrint: Designing Feel Aesthetics for Digital Fabrication
summary: A pair of design tools for digital fabrication that let users modify the feel of 3D printed models, mapping textures onto surfaces and controlling internal infill for compliance and weight.

title: FoveAR: Combining an Optically See-Through Near-Eye Display with Projector-Based Spatial Augmented Reality
summary: A hybrid augmented reality display that combines an optically see-through near-eye display with projector-based spatial augmented reality, giving a much wider field of view and view-dependent graphics for AR experiences.

title: Foldio: Digital Fabrication of Interactive and Shape-Changing Objects With Foldable Printed Electronics
summary: A design and fabrication approach for foldable interactive objects that automatically generates print-and-fold layouts with printed electronics from a 3D model, enabling touch input, display output and shape-changing objects.

title: Encore: 3D Printed Augmentation of Everyday Objects with Printed-Over, Affixed and Interlocked Attachments
summary: A framework and design tool for 3D printing attachments that augment existing everyday objects, with print-over, print-to-affix and print-through techniques and analysis of viability, durability and usability.

title: NanoStylus: Enhancing Input on Ultra-Small Displays with a Finger-Mounted Stylus
summary: A finger-mounted stylus that enables fast, accurate pointing with little occlusion on smartwatches and other ultra-small displays, plus side touchpads for additional gestures.

title: Capricate: A Fabrication Pipeline to Design and 3D Print Capacitive Touch Sensors for Interactive Objects
summary: A fabrication pipeline and design tool for rapid prototyping that lets people design and 3D print interactive objects with embedded capacitive multi-touch sensors of custom shape, including on doubly curved surfaces.

title: Protopiper: Physically Sketching Room-Sized Objects at Actual Scale
summary: A computer aided, hand-held fabrication device that forms adhesive tape into tubes with connectors, letting users physically sketch room-sized objects at actual scale during rapid prototyping.

title: Leveraging Dual-Observable Input for Fine-Grained Thumb Interaction Using Forearm EMG
summary: A forearm-based EMG input system that recognizes fine-grained thumb gestures, trained through dual-observable input, where a phone's recognition of gestures labels training data for an always-available input device.

title: SensorTape: Modular and Programmable 3D-Aware Dense Sensor Network on a Tape
summary: A modular, cuttable dense sensor network in the form factor of a tape, with programmable sensor nodes that self-configure, sense their own deformation and proximity, and are programmed through a graphical interface.

title: Makers' Marks: Physical Markup for Designing and Fabricating Functional Objects
summary: A system for designing and 3D printing functional objects, where makers physically sculpt shapes and attach annotation stickers that are scanned and turned into mounting geometry for existing mechanical and electronic parts.

title: Sensing Tablet Grasp + Micro-mobility for Active Reading
summary: A set of interaction techniques using capacitive grip sensing and inertial motion on tablets to support active reading alone, between two users, and across multiple tablets, based on observed grasp and micro-mobility.

title: Printem: Instant Printed Circuit Boards with Standard Office Printers & Inks
summary: A novel film-based method for fabricating printed circuit boards for small batch and rapid prototyping, letting people produce conductive copper PCBs with a standard office inkjet or laser printer and UV or sunlight exposure.

title: LaserStacker: Fabricating 3D Objects by Laser Cutting and Welding
summary: A system for rapid prototyping that uses a laser cutter to cut, weld and heal stacked acrylic sheets, so users fabricate assembled 3D objects, including ones with moving parts, without manual assembly.

title: Reprise: A Design Tool for Specifying, Generating, and Customizing 3D Printable Adaptations on Everyday Objects
summary: A design tool for specifying, generating, customizing and fitting 3D printable adaptations onto everyday objects, letting users with limited 3D modeling experience create assistive and lifehacking add-ons.

title: Exploring the Design Space for Energy-Harvesting Situated Displays
summary: An exploration of the design space for energy-harvesting situated displays, yielding a thin, wireless, photovoltaic-powered e-paper display with Bluetooth Low-Energy that can run indefinitely in indoor lighting.

title: RadarCat: Radar Categorization for Input & Interaction
summary: A radar-based sensing technique that uses machine learning to classify materials, objects and body parts placed on or touched by a small radar sensor, enabling new forms of proximate interaction.

title: Foundry: Hierarchical Material Design for Multi-Material Fabrication
summary: An interactive system for hierarchically designing spatially-varying material definitions for multi-material fabrication, composing operators into an operator graph so users can design and 3D print functional multi-material parts.

title: Holoportation: Virtual 3D Teleportation in Real-time
summary: An end-to-end telepresence system using depth cameras for real-time 3D capture and transmission, letting remote users wearing augmented or virtual reality displays see, hear and interact as if co-present.

title: Immersive Scuba Diving Simulator Using Virtual Reality
summary: A virtual reality scuba diving simulator that combines a motion platform, suspended harness, breathing-controlled buoyancy, temperature and tactile feedback with a head-mounted display, letting people experience diving in a terrestrial setting.

title: aeroMorph - Heat-sealing Inflatable Shape-change Materials for Interaction Design
summary: A design, simulation and fabrication pipeline using heat-sealed pneumatic hinges that lets designers make transforming inflatables from paper, plastics and fabrics for shape-changing interfaces, wearables, toys and furniture.

title: Stretchis: Fabricating Highly Stretchable User Interfaces
summary: A fabrication method for highly stretchable user interfaces that screen-prints transparent touch and proximity sensors and electroluminescent displays on PDMS, enabling non-expert makers to add interaction to elastic objects, fabrics and skin.

title: EdgeVib: Effective Alphanumeric Character Output Using a Wrist-Worn Tactile Display
summary: A set of multistroke spatiotemporal vibration patterns, based on EdgeWrite, for delivering alphanumeric characters on a low-resolution wrist-worn tactile display, with design guidelines drawn from user studies.

title: A 3D Printer for Interactive Electromagnetic Devices
summary: A low-cost 3D printer with a five degree of freedom FDM platform and a wire-depositing print head that prints wound-in-place copper coils and soft iron cores, enabling interactive electromagnetic actuators and sensors.

title: HoloFlex: A Flexible Light-Field Smartphone with a Microlens Array and a P-OLED Touchscreen
summary: A flexible smartphone with a light-field display made of a P-OLED screen and microlens array that shows glasses-free 3D images and uses bend input for z-axis interaction with 3D objects.

title: NormalTouch and TextureTouch: High-fidelity 3D Haptic Shape Rendering on Handheld Virtual Reality Controllers
summary: Two mechanically-actuated handheld controllers for virtual reality that render the shape, surface texture and forces of virtual objects to the finger, letting users feel 3D shapes while exploring virtual scenes.

title: CircuitStack: Supporting Rapid Prototyping and Evolution of Electronic Circuits
summary: A hybrid system of a breadboard and stacked printed circuit boards sandwiching printed circuit paper, enabling rapid circuit prototyping with reconfigurable circuits and reusable components converted directly from breadboard schematics.

title: Digital Gastronomy: Methods & Recipes for Hybrid Cooking
summary: A hybrid kitchen and cooking methodology that combines manual cooking with digital fabrication tools and parametric design, using hybrid recipes with degrees of freedom that can be set digitally to personalize dishes.

title: TRing: Instant and Customizable Interactions with Objects Using an Embedded Magnet and a Finger-Worn Device
summary: A finger-worn input device that tracks the fingertip around a small embedded magnet using magnetic sensing, making plain and existing objects interactive with customizable controls such as buttons and sliders.

title: Muscle-plotter: An Interactive System based on Electrical Muscle Stimulation that Produces Spatial Output
summary: An interactive system based on electrical muscle stimulation that lets users write with a pen on paper while the system steers their wrist to plot charts and widgets, producing spatial output.

title: Rovables: Miniature On-Body Robots as Mobile Wearables
summary: A miniature untethered robot with magnetic wheels that moves on unmodified clothing, with onboard localization, letting on-body mobile wearables provide sensing, tactile feedback, displays and interactive jewelry.

title: GyroVR: Simulating Inertia in Virtual Reality using Head Worn Flywheels
summary: A device of head worn flywheels that leverages the gyroscopic effect to simulate the kinesthetic force of inertia in Virtual Reality, ungrounded and wireless, letting users feel resistance when moving their head.

title: Metamaterial Mechanisms
summary: A concept of metamaterial mechanisms, single blocks of 3D-printable cells including a shear cell that perform mechanical functions, plus a specialized 3D editor to design and simulate them for personal fabrication.

title: Zooids: Building Blocks for Swarm User Interfaces
summary: A platform of small wheeled micro robots, a radio base-station and projector-based tracking for building tabletop swarm user interfaces, whose robots act as display and input that users can manipulate directly.

title: Phyxel: Realistic Display of Shape and Appearance using Physical Objects with High-speed Pixelated Lighting
summary: A display technology that synchronizes periodic actuation of physical materials with high-speed pixelated lighting from a projector, so the naked eye perceives realistic 3D shape and material appearance.

title: JOLED: A Mid-air Display based on Electrostatic Rotation of Levitated Janus Objects
summary: A mid-air display that uses acoustic levitation for 3D position and electrostatic rotation of levitated Janus objects as physical voxels, enabling interactive physical visualization and mid-air games.

title: RealPen: Providing Realism in Handwriting Tasks on Touch Surfaces using Auditory-Tactile Feedback
summary: An augmented stylus for capacitive tablet screens that recreates the auditory-tactile feel of writing with a pencil, ball-point pen or marker on paper, making handwriting on touch surfaces more realistic.

title: Crowdsourced Fabrication
summary: A model of crowdsourced fabrication, with an intelligent construction space using smartwatches, indoor location sensing, instrumented materials and a coordinating engine to guide many untrained volunteers in building a large-scale structure.

title: Changing the Appearance of Physical Interfaces Through Controlled Transparency
summary: A technique for building physical interfaces that change their appearance through controlled transparency, by laser cutting and folding a single sheet of switchable diffuser with engraved electrical routing, for ambient display uses.

title: LIME: LIquid MEtal Interfaces for Non-Rigid Interaction
summary: An enabling technology of electrically controllable room-temperature liquid metal cells and widgets (shutters, selection, controlling and haptic widgets) for non-rigid, shape-changing interfaces with visual effects and dynamic haptic feedback.

title: WristWhirl: One-handed Continuous Smartwatch Input using Wrist Gestures
summary: An input technique using the wrist as an always-available joystick for one-handed continuous input on smartwatches, with a watchband proximity-sensor prototype for drawing gestures while standing or walking.

title: The Toastboard: Ubiquitous Instrumentation and Automated Checking of Breadboarded Circuits
summary: A debugging tool for breadboarded circuits that ubiquitously instruments every breadboard row, shows circuit state with LEDs and a web interface, and runs software-based component testers to diagnose common errors automatically.

title: AuraSense: Enabling Expressive Around-Smartwatch Interactions with Electric Field Sensing
summary: A technique that augments an off-the-shelf smartwatch with electric field sensing and varied antenna configurations, enabling around-device interaction such as on-skin buttons, sliders, trackpad, radial input and hand gestures.

title: proCover: Sensory Augmentation of Prosthetic Limbs Using Smart Textile Covers
summary: A concept and prototype of a smart textile sensing sock worn over lower-limb prosthetics, with user-driven mapping of sensing regions to wearable haptic feedback actuators, letting amputees sense touch and pressure.

title: Advancing Hand Gesture Recognition with High Resolution Electrical Impedance Tomography
summary: A system for hand gesture recognition using high resolution Electrical Impedance Tomography on a wristband, with faster sampling and more electrodes, comparing two-pole and four-pole sensing methods and electrode resolutions.

title: FaceTouch: Enabling Touch Interaction in Display Fixed UIs for Mobile Virtual Reality
summary: An interaction technique for mobile virtual reality head-mounted displays that uses a touch-sensitive surface on the back of the HMD to select display-fixed UI elements via proprioception.

title: Aesthetic Electronics: Designing, Sketching, and Fabricating Circuits through Digital Exploration
summary: A digital design tool for sketching and fabricating electronic circuits with multiple conductive and dielectric materials, validating the circuit and guiding fabrication and debugging while supporting aesthetic design choices.

title: ViBand: High-Fidelity Bio-Acoustic Sensing Using Commodity Smartwatch Accelerometers
summary: A technique that boosts the sampling rate of a commodity smartwatch accelerometer with a custom kernel to enable bio-acoustic sensing of hand gestures, grasped objects, and data transmitted through the body.

title: Designing a Non-contact Wearable Tactile Display Using Airflows
summary: A non-contact wearable tactile display using airflows, with psychophysical data on airflow perception thresholds on body locations, letting designers build airflow-based wearable tactile displays comparable to vibrotactile ones.

title: Mobile Fabrication
summary: An exploration of mobile fabrication, personal fabrication on the go, using two prototypes (a retrofitted mobile 3D printer and a human-assisted extruder pen) with phone apps and a solution database for fixing things.

title: ChainFORM: A Linear Integrated Modular Hardware System for Shape Changing Interfaces
summary: A linear, modular, actuated hardware system of chained modules with integrated touch sensing, angular detection, LED display and servo actuation, for building customizable shape changing interfaces and prototyping tools.

title: SkyAnchor: Optical Design for Anchoring Mid-air Images onto Physical Objects
summary: An optical design using two mirrors and an aerial-imaging plate that anchors mid-air images onto moving physical objects without latency, for glass-free mixed reality on a touch table.

title: FlexStylus: Leveraging Bend Input for Pen Interaction
summary: A flexible stylus that senses barrel deformation as bend input with two degrees of freedom, enabling pen interaction techniques for menu navigation, tool selection and parametric control in digital drawing.

title: iSphere: Self-Luminous Spherical Drone Display
summary: A flying spherical display built from a drone and rotating arcuate LED tapes using persistence of vision, giving bright, high resolution images in all directions from anywhere in 3D space.

title: Reinventing the Wheel: Transforming Steering Wheel Systems for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Two transforming steering wheel systems, one mechanically transforming robotic wheel and one visually transforming LED wheel, for alerting drivers during a transition of control in autonomous vehicles.

title: FacePush: Introducing Normal Force on Face with Head-Mounted Displays
summary: A head-mounted display integrated with a pulley system and motors that generates normal forces on the user's face in virtual reality, enabling haptic feedback for boxing, diving and attention guidance.

title: SoundBender: Dynamic Acoustic Control Behind Obstacles
summary: A hybrid ultrasound modulator combining phased arrays of transducers with 3D-printed acoustic metamaterials to create dynamic self-bending beams, enabling levitation and tactile feedback around obstacles.

title: SynchronizAR: Instant Synchronization for Spontaneous and Spatial Collaborations in Augmented Reality
summary: An approach that instantly registers multiple SLAM based mobile AR devices spatially using Ultra-Wide Bandwidth distance measurements, without sharing maps or external tracking, enabling spontaneous co-located collaborative augmented reality.

title: SilentVoice: Unnoticeable Voice Input by Ingressive Speech
DualPanto: A Haptic Device that Enables Blind Users to Continuously Interact with Virtual Worlds
summary: A haptic device with two spatially registered pantograph force-feedback handles that lets blind users continuously track moving objects while acting in virtual worlds, such as in sports or shooter games.

title: InfiniTouch: Finger-Aware Interaction on Fully Touch Sensitive Smartphones
summary: A smartphone prototype with capacitive touch sensing on the whole device surface and a convolutional neural network that identifies which fingers touch it, enabling finger-aware interaction without external sensors.

title: TrussFormer: 3D Printing Large Kinetic Structures
summary: An end-to-end system that lets users design, verify and 3D print large-scale kinetic truss structures by adding linear actuators, checking dynamic forces, and generating printable hinge systems for desktop 3D printers.

title: Vibrosight: Long-Range Vibrometry for Smart Environment Sensing
summary: A sensing approach using long-range laser vibrometry and retroreflective tags to detect appliance use and human activities across entire rooms, supporting context-aware sensing of simultaneous activities in smart environments.

title: Ubicoustics: Plug-and-Play Acoustic Activity Recognition
summary: A real-time, sound-based activity recognition system that tunes an existing sound labeling model with augmented professional sound effect library data, enabling plug-and-play recognition on microphone-equipped devices without end-user training.

title: Magneto-Haptics: Embedding Magnetic Force Feedback for Physical Interactions
summary: A design approach that computes a haptic potential curve from the forces among permanent magnets during active touch, letting people design non-electric magnet-embedded haptic sensations and physical interfaces.

title: Shape-Aware Material: Interactive Fabrication with ShapeMe
summary: A smart material with printed capacitive length-aware sensors and a software toolkit that capture its own geometry as it is physically cut, linking physical modeling and digital 3D modeling in interactive fabrication.

title: RFIMatch: Distributed Batteryless Near-Field Identification Using RFID-Tagged Magnet-Biased Reed Switches
summary: A technique for distributed batteryless near-field identification between two passive RFID tags, using magnet-biased reed switches that give contactless, orientation-invariant sensing with native haptic feedback for embedded and wearable use.

title: 4DMesh: 4D Printing Morphing Non-Developable Mesh Surfaces
summary: A method combining shrinking and bending thermoplastic actuators with inverse design algorithms to 4D print flat sheets that morph into centimeter- to meter-sized non-developable mesh surfaces when heated.

title: MobiLimb: Augmenting Mobile Devices with a Robotic Limb
summary: A small 5-DOF serial robotic manipulator attached to a mobile device that extends its I/O capabilities, used as a tool, partner and medium for haptic feedback and interaction.

title: RollingStone: Using Single Slip Taxel for Enhancing Active Finger Exploration with a Virtual Reality Controller
summary: A virtual reality controller with a single two-degree-of-freedom ball-based slip tactile pixel under the fingertip that produces sensations of finger sliding and artificial textures during active finger exploration.

title: PuPoP: Pop-up Prop on Palm for Virtual Reality
summary: A light-weight wearable pneumatic shape-proxy interface worn on the palm that pops up airbags with primitive shapes for grasping virtual objects in virtual reality (VR), enhancing realism and enjoyment.

title: Orecchio: Extending Body-Language through Actuated Static and Dynamic Auricular Postures
summary: A study of how static and dynamic auricular postures convey emotional states, plus a wearable earpiece that actuates the auricle to extend body language as expressive output.

title: ShareSpace: Facilitating Shared Use of the Physical Space by both VR Head-Mounted Display and External Users
summary: A system of physical shield tools and a visualizer that lets external users place virtual shields to communicate their need for physical space to VR head-mounted display (HMD) users sharing the same room.

title: Self-Powered Gesture Recognition with Ambient Light
summary: A self-powered gesture recognition module that uses photodiodes for both energy harvesting from ambient light and sensing finger gestures, letting battery-free wearables like smart glasses and smart watches recognize touch and midair gestures.

title: Asterisk and Obelisk: Motion Codes for Passive Tagging
summary: A passive tagging mechanism, Motion Codes, in which users trace a printed visual pattern with a finger-worn inertial motion sensing (IMU) ring to read encoded information, with two schemes for encoding and decoding.

title: I/O Braid: Scalable Touch-Sensitive Lighted Cords Using Spiraling, Repeating Sensing Textiles and Fiber Optics
summary: An interactive textile cord that senses proximity, touch and twist through a spiraling, repeating braiding topology of touch matrices, with braided fiber optics for integrated visual feedback on everyday objects.

title: Wireless Analytics for 3D Printed Objects
summary: A wireless physical analytics system for 3D printed objects that uses conductive plastic filaments for room-scale backscatter sensing of bi-directional motion, plus a mechanical ratchet and gear mechanism to store usage data without electronics.

title: CamTrackPoint: Camera-Based Pointing Stick Using Transmitted Light through Finger
summary: A pointing stick-like input interface for mobile devices that mounts a 3D-printed spring-suspended ring on the front or rear camera bezel and tracks light transmitted through the finger, giving force feedback.

title: VR Grabbers: Ungrounded Haptic Retargeting for Precision Grabbing Tools
summary: An interaction technique for virtual reality that retargets the visual opening angle of a handheld grabbing tool, with a passive chopsticks-like controller, to give realistic ungrounded haptic feedback when grabbing virtual objects.

title: FDSense: Estimating Young's Modulus and Stiffness of End Effectors to Facilitate Kinetic Interaction on Touch Surfaces
summary: A touch technique that estimates the Young's modulus and stiffness of an end effector from force and contact area measured on a touchpad, enabling kinetic interaction such as digital painting and drumming.

title: Tacttoo: A Thin and Feel-Through Tattoo for On-Skin Tactile Output
summary: A thin, feel-through temporary tattoo interface for electro-tactile output on the skin, fabricated with DIY screen printing and a safety architecture, enabling high-density tactile output for tactile augmented reality and on-skin interaction.

title: ElectricItch: Skin Irritation as a Feedback Modality
summary: A study of itching, created through low-current electric stimulation from a custom wearable stimulator, as a skin irritation feedback modality for notifications on wearables such as a smartwatch.

title: Touch+Finger: Extending Touch-based User Interface Capabilities with "Idle" Finger Gestures in the Air
summary: An interaction technique that augments touch input with hand poses and in-air gestures of the "idle" fingers, tracked with ring-like devices, to extend touch-based user interface capabilities.

title: Assembly-aware Design of Printable Electromechanical Devices
summary: A computational design system that optimizes layout, mounting structures and assembly plans so casual users can make 3D printed enclosures housing off-the-shelf electromechanical components, supporting digital fabrication of devices.

title: Haptic Feedback to the Palm and Fingers for Improved Tactile Perception of Large Objects
summary: A wearable haptic interface giving kinesthetic feedback to the thumb, index and middle fingers and cutaneous feedback on the palm, with a haptic rendering strategy, improving perception of large virtual objects.

title: DextrES: Wearable Haptic Feedback for Grasping in VR via a Thin Form-Factor Electrostatic Brake
summary: A thin, lightweight wearable haptic glove using an electrostatic brake for kinesthetic feedback and piezo actuators for cutaneous feedback, enabling precise grasping of virtual objects in VR.

title: GridDrones: A Self-Levitating Physical Voxel Lattice for Interactive 3D Surface Deformations
summary: A self-levitating programmable matter platform of cube-shaped nanocopters forming a midair voxel lattice, letting people interactively select and deform 2.5D relief surfaces with unsupported structures and 3D transformations.

title: Dynablock: Dynamic 3D Printing for Instant and Reconstructable Shape Formation
summary: A class of systems called Dynamic 3D Printing that uses a pin-based shape display as a parallel assembler of small magnetic blocks, forming graspable, reconstructable three-dimensional shapes in seconds.

title: Indutivo: Contact-Based, Object-Driven Interactions with Inductive Sensing
summary: A contact-based inductive sensing technique for a smartwatch that recognizes everyday conductive objects and tracks their sliding, hinging and rotation against the sensor for contextual interactions.

title: RESi: A Highly Flexible, Pressure-Sensitive, Imperceptible Textile Interface Based on Resistive Yarns
summary: A yarn-based resistive pressure-sensing textile technology, with a conductive metallic core and resistive carbon coating, plus a platform-independent API for rapid prototyping of interactive textiles via sewing, embroidery and weaving.

title: MetaArms: Body Remapping Using Feet-Controlled Artificial Arms
summary: Wearable anthropomorphic robotic arms and hands worn on a backpack and controlled by the user's feet and toes with haptic feedback to the soles, a body-remapping approach to artificial limbs.

title: HydroRing: Supporting Mixed Reality Haptics Using Liquid Flow
summary: A finger-worn haptic device that delivers pressure, vibration and temperature sensations on the fingertip through liquid flow in a thin latex tube, enabling mixed-reality haptics without impeding natural touch.

title: Opisthenar: Hand Poses and Finger Tapping Recognition by Observing Back of Hand Using Embedded Wrist Camera
summary: A vision-based technique that uses a camera on the wrist observing the back of the hand (opisthenar) with deep neural networks to recognize static hand poses and dynamic finger tapping gestures.

title: ActiTouch: Robust Touch Detection for On-Skin AR/VR Interfaces
summary: An electrical method using the body as an RF waveguide, combined with computer vision, for robust on-skin touch detection that enables touchscreen-like interactions on the skin in AR/VR interfaces.

title: SWISH: A Shifting-Weight Interface of Simulated Hydrodynamics for Haptic Perception of Virtual Fluid Vessels
summary: An ungrounded mixed-reality haptic interface that uses tracking and motor actuation to shift the center of gravity of a handheld vessel, giving users the sensation of virtual fluid in virtual reality.

title: Virtual Muscle Force: Communicating Kinesthetic Forces Through Pseudo-Haptic Feedback and Muscle Input
summary: A technique that enriches pseudo-haptic feedback in virtual reality with muscle tension as an additional input, mapped to a virtual force, to communicate kinesthetic forces without haptic hardware.

title: StateLens: A Reverse Engineering Solution for Making Existing Dynamic Touchscreens Accessible
summary: A reverse engineering solution that builds state diagrams of existing dynamic touchscreens from point-of-view videos with a hybrid crowd-computer vision pipeline, plus conversational agents and 3D-printed accessories, letting blind users access them.

title: Pull-Ups: Enhancing Suspension Activities in Virtual Reality with Body-Scale Kinesthetic Force Feedback
summary: A suspension exercise kit using pneumatic artificial muscles that gives body-scale kinesthetic force feedback, letting users perform suspension activities such as kitesurfing and paragliding in virtual reality.

title: DreamWalker: Substituting Real-World Walking Experiences with a Virtual Reality
summary: A virtual reality system that fuses inside-out tracking, GPS and RGB depth sensing to let users real-walk uncontrolled outdoor environments while immersed in a virtual world, redirected and kept collision-free.

title: Knitting Skeletons: A Computer-Aided Design Tool for Shaping and Patterning of Knitted Garments
summary: A web-based computer-aided design tool that composes parametric knitted primitives and layered stitch patterns, letting casual users customize the shape and patterning of machine-knitted whole garments.

title: GesturePod: Enabling On-device Gesture-based Interaction for White Cane Users
summary: A low-cost device that clips onto any white cane and recognizes cane gestures on-device with a resource-constrained machine learning pipeline, letting people with visual impairment trigger smartphone tasks without touch.

title: LeviProps: Animating Levitated Optimized Fabric Structures using Holographic Acoustic Tweezers
summary: A design and fabrication method, with an optimizing authoring tool, for levitated props made of lightweight fabric and anchor beads that holographic acoustic tweezers manipulate in mid-air with six degrees of freedom.

title: LightAnchors: Appropriating Point Lights for Spatially-Anchored Augmented Reality Interfaces
summary: A method that blinks point lights such as LEDs to encode data, letting smartphone augmented reality applications anchor and display information on everyday objects without special hardware or connectivity.

title: A 3D Printer Head as a Robotic Manipulator
summary: A technique that customizes a low-cost fused deposition modeling 3D printer to attach printed end-effectors, using the printer head as a 3-axis robotic manipulator to assemble parts, break supports and actuate printed objects.

title: KnitPicking Textures: Programming and Modifying Complex Knitted Textures for Machine and Hand Knitting
summary: A pipeline that compiles hand-knitting texture patterns into graphs for machine and hand knitting, with algorithms to resize and combine knitted textures for fabricating textured knitted objects.

title: HapSense: A Soft Haptic I/O Device with Uninterrupted Dual Functionalities of Force Sensing and Vibrotactile Actuation
summary: A single-volume soft haptic I/O device built from a multilayer ferroelectric electroactive polymer that senses force while delivering vibrotactile actuation, with a low-cost fabrication process and portable driving hardware.

title: MeCap: Whole-Body Digitization for Low-Cost VR/AR Headsets
summary: An accessory of two mirrored hemispheres viewed by a smartphone's rear-facing camera that adds motion capture of body pose, hand pose, mouth state and appearance to low-cost VR/AR headsets.

title: CapstanCrunch: A Haptic VR Controller with User-supplied Force Feedback
summary: A palm-grounded haptic VR controller using a motor-controlled capstan-plus-cord friction brake and clutched spring to render touch and grasp feedback of rigid and compliant objects at human-scale forces in virtual reality.

title: Soft Inkjet Circuits: Rapid Multi-Material Fabrication of Soft Circuits using a Commodity Inkjet Printer
summary: A process for rapid do-it-yourself fabrication of stretchable and soft circuits on multiple substrates, using multiple functional inks in a commodity desktop inkjet printer, enabling e-textiles, e-tattoos and re-shapeable interfaces.

title: Robiot: A Design Tool for Actuating Everyday Objects with Automatically Generated 3D Printable Mechanisms
summary: A design tool that lets end-users demonstrate a physical task on an everyday object in a video and automatically generates 3D printable actuation mechanisms to automate it.

title: Multi-Touch Kit: A Do-It-Yourself Technique for Capacitive Multi-Touch Sensing Using a Commodity Microcontroller
summary: A do-it-yourself technique for capacitive multi-touch sensing with a commodity microcontroller and open-source software, letting electronics novices rapidly prototype multi-touch sensors of custom size, shape and materials.

title: 3D Printed Fabric: Techniques for Design and 3D Weaving Programmable Textiles
summary: A 3D printing technique for fabricating soft, flexible, programmable textiles by weaving fibers across pillars with the nozzle of a consumer grade FDM 3D printer, plus a design tool for parameterized textile patterns.

title: Tessutivo: Contextual Interactions on Interactive Fabrics with Inductive Sensing
summary: A contact-based inductive sensing technique using spiral coils of conductive thread sewn into interactive fabrics, recognizing conductive objects such as keys and coins to enable contextual interactions.

title: Masque: Exploring Lateral Skin Stretch Feedback on the Face with Head-Mounted Displays
summary: A head-mounted display prototype with an array of shear tactors that produces two-dimensional lateral skin stretch feedback on the face, enabling force and directional haptic cues in virtual reality.

title: Self-healing UI: Mechanically and Electrically Self-healing Materials for Sensing and Actuation Interfaces
summary: A soft-bodied interface built from self-healing polymer and conductive composite materials, fabricated by layer-by-layer stacking, enabling shape-changing interfaces with sensing and actuation that heal, fuse, reconfigure and conform.

title: Ohmic-Sticker: Force-to-Motion Type Input Device that Extends Capacitive Touch Surface
summary: A thin, battery-less force-to-motion type input device that attaches to commercial capacitive touchpads or touchscreens, giving them force-sensitive inputs such as TrackPoint-like pointing and 6 DoF control.

title: Portal-ble: Intuitive Free-hand Manipulation in Unbounded Smartphone-based Augmented Reality
summary: A smartphone-based augmented reality system with 3D hand tracking and feedback and accommodation mechanisms that lets users grab and manipulate virtual objects with their free hands while moving around unbounded spaces.

title: Photo-Chromeleon: Re-Programmable Multi-Color Textures Using Photochromic Dyes
summary: A method for creating re-programmable multi-color textures from a single material by mixing cyan, magenta and yellow photochromic dyes and controlling each channel with a modified projector, letting users transfer virtual textures onto physical objects.

title: Tip-Tap: Battery-free Discrete 2D Fingertip Input
summary: A wearable, battery-free input technique using a custom RFID tag that senses 2-dimensional discrete touch events from the intersection of contact arrays on the index fingertip and thumb tip.

title: Mantis: A Scalable, Lightweight and Accessible Architecture to Build Multiform Force Feedback Systems
summary: An open-source, scalable, lightweight and accessible system architecture using brushless DC motors, custom electronic controllers and admittance control to build multiform force feedback systems, from desktop to large-workspace, mobile and wearable devices.

title: RFTouchPads: Batteryless and Wireless Modular Touch Sensor Pads Based on RFID
summary: A system of batteryless, wireless, modular two-dimensional touch sensor pads based on UHF RFID tags, in flexible and tileable forms, enabling fine-grained touch input in ubiquitous computing applications.

title: ShapeBots: Shape-changing Swarm Robots
summary: A concept and prototype of shape-changing swarm robots, self-transformable robots with miniature linear actuators that individually and collectively change shape to display information, actuate objects, and provide physical affordances.

title: SensorSnaps: Integrating Wireless Sensor Nodes into Fabric Snap Fasteners for Textile Interfaces
summary: Low-power wireless sensor nodes that integrate into the caps of fabric snap fasteners, letting people quickly add gesture and motion sensing to clothing for textile interfaces.

title: StackMold: Rapid Prototyping of Functional Multi-Material Objects with Selective Levels of Surface Details
summary: A DIY molding technique and software environment for rapid prototyping of multi-material, multi-colored functional objects with embedded electronics, using laser-cut multi-stage molds with selectively 3D-printed high-detail regions.

title: Turn-by-Wire: Computationally Mediated Physical Fabrication
summary: A hybrid-controlled lathe with force feedback handwheels and a graphical user interface that mediates digital fabrication with haptic feedback, letting novice and expert makers perceive state, get scaffolding and communicate intent.

title: CircuitStyle: A System for Peripherally Reinforcing Best Practices in Hardware Computing
summary: A web-based teaching aid for in-person hardware computing workshops that lets instructors author circuit tutorials and style guides and peripherally reinforce circuit style best practices while tracking student progress.

title: BubBowl: Display Vessel Using Electrolysis Bubbles in Drinkable Beverages
summary: A liquid-surface bubble display technique using electrolysis-generated bubble clusters as pixels, embedded in a cup-type vessel, that shows dot-matrix information on drinkable beverages without external gas supply or moving parts.

title: Aero-plane: A Handheld Force-Feedback Device that Renders Weight Motion Illusion on a Virtual 2D Plane
summary: A handheld force-feedback device based on two miniature jet-propellers that renders a weight motion illusion of shifting weight on a virtual 2D plane for virtual reality controllers.

title: SpringFit: Joints and Mounts that Fabricate on Any Laser Cutter
summary: A software tool that converts 2D cutting plans for laser cutting by replacing press-fit mounts and joints with cantilever spring-based ones, so models fabricate on any laser cutter and material.

title: ElastImpact: 2.5D Multilevel Instant Impact Using Elasticity on Head-Mounted Displays
summary: A wearable device using elastic bands, motors and a proxy collider on a head-mounted display to render multilevel instant impact in normal and tangential directions for virtual reality.

title: SCALE: Enhancing Force-based Interaction by Processing Load Data from Load Sensitive Modules
summary: A prototyping toolkit and framework that processes load data from modular load sensitive modules to support force-based interaction: touch detection in 2D and 3D, object status tracking and motion pattern recognition.

title: Tactlets: Adding Tactile Feedback to 3D Objects Using Custom Printed Controls
summary: A digital design and fabrication approach for rapid prototyping of custom printed controls with electro-tactile output and integrated touch sensing on curved 3D objects, using a design tool and conductive inkjet or 3D printing.

title: Proxino: Enabling Prototyping of Virtual Circuits with Physical Proxies
summary: A circuit prototyping environment that links virtual breadboard circuits to real input and output components used as physical proxies, enabling novice makers to test circuits physically, collaborate remotely and prototype on mobile devices.

title: PseudoBend: Producing Haptic Illusions of Stretching, Bending, and Twisting Using Grain Vibrations
summary: A haptic feedback technique that uses grain vibrations from a force sensor and vibrotactile actuator to create the illusion that a rigid handheld device is being stretched, bent, or twisted.

title: Skin-On Interfaces: A Bio-Driven Approach for Artificial Skin Design to Cover Interactive Devices
summary: A paradigm and bio-driven design exploration of covering interactive devices with artificial skin made of silicone with embedded sensing, plus an open toolkit and fabrication method, enabling new input gestures such as twist and scratch.

title: FaceWidgets: Exploring Tangible Interaction on Face with Head-Mounted Displays
summary: A head-mounted display augmented on its backside with physical controls on an extendable lift, plus a widget canvas and palm-facing gesture, enabling tangible direct-manipulation interaction for mobile VR.

title: Accurate and Low-Latency Sensing of Touch Contact on Any Surface with Finger-Worn IMU Sensor
summary: A technique using a finger-worn ring with an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensor to sense touch contact on any surface accurately and with low latency, complementing optical touch sensing in head-mounted mixed reality.

title: Interactive 360-Degree Glasses-Free Tabletop 3D Display
summary: An interactive 360-degree glasses-free tabletop 3D display that uses linear blending with fewer projectors, multi-user head tracking from a 360-degree camera, and a tablet, letting multiple users collaborate around a round table.

title: Morphlour: Personalized Flour-based Morphing Food Induced by Dehydration or Hydration Method
summary: A design strategy, computational design tool and hybrid fabrication method for flour-based morphing food whose shape changes through grooved dough during dehydration (baking) or hydration (boiling), enabling personalized shape-changing food.

title: PrivateTalk: Activating Voice Input with Hand-On-Mouth Gesture Detected by Bluetooth Earphones
summary: An on-body interaction technique that activates voice input when users cover the mouth with a hand while speaking, detected by comparing the audio received by two Bluetooth earphones.

title: Ondulé: Designing and Controlling 3D Printable Springs
summary: An interactive design tool for novices that converts selected geometries into 3D-printable helical springs with embedded joints, giving parameterizable deformation behaviors such as compress, extend, twist and bend for digital fabrication.

title: Sozu: Self-Powered Radio Tags for Building-Scale Activity Sensing
summary: A low-cost, battery-free activity sensing system whose self-powered tags convert energy from sensed activities into RF broadcasts, detecting events wirelessly through walls at whole-building scale.

title: Third-Person Piloting: Increasing Situational Awareness using a Spatially Coupled Second Drone
summary: A drone manipulation interface that increases situational awareness by giving the pilot an interactive third-person perspective from a spatially coupled second drone, steered with a miniature drone on the controller.

title: InfoLED: Augmenting LED Indicator Lights for Device Positioning and Communication
summary: A positioning and communication system for Augmented Reality that modulates existing LED indicator lights with high-frequency flicker so appliances transmit location, IDs and status to a smartphone without changing their look.

title: M-Hair: Creating Novel Tactile Feedback by Augmenting the Body Hair to Respond to Magnetic Field
summary: A technique for creating tactile feedback by applying passive magnetic materials to body hair and actuating it with external magnetic fields, enabling non-contact haptic stimulation without touching the skin.

title: milliMorph -- Fluid-Driven Thin Film Shape-Change Materials for Interaction Design
summary: A design space and heat sealing fabrication system for creating millimeter-scale fluidic chambers and channels in thin film shape-change materials, enabling high frequency actuation and sequential control for tangible actuated interfaces.

title: TilePoP: Tile-type Pop-up Prop for Virtual Reality
summary: A pneumatically-actuated interface deployed as floor tiles of stacked folding airbags that pop up into body-scale physical props, providing whole-body haptic feedback in Virtual Reality.

title: Direction-of-Voice (DoV) Estimation for Intuitive Speech Interaction with Smart Devices Ecosystems
summary: A technique that estimates the direction of a user's voice from a small microphone array in smart devices, letting voice commands be addressed to a particular device without wake-words or external sensors.

title: Omni: Volumetric Sensing and Actuation of Passive Magnetic Tools for Dynamic Haptic Feedback
summary: A self-contained haptic feedback device with a spherical electromagnet and integrated hall sensors that tracks and actuates an untethered passive magnetic tool, enabling dynamic haptic feedback for AR, VR and desktop applications.

title: KnitGIST: A Programming Synthesis Toolkit for Generating Functional Machine-Knitting Textures
summary: A program synthesis toolkit and library that generates functional hand- and machine-knitting textures by mapping objectives to tactics, producing knittable programs in a domain-specific language for digital fabrication.

title: Optimal Control for Electromagnetic Haptic Guidance Systems
summary: A real-time optimal control method for electromagnetic haptic guidance systems that gently pulls users' pens towards a target trajectory for drawing and sketching while letting them override it and draw at their own speed.

title: HapLinkage: Prototyping Haptic Proxies for Virtual Hand Tools Using Linkage Mechanism
summary: A prototyping framework based on linkage mechanisms, with motion templates, an actuating module and a CAD plug-in, for designing and building haptic proxies of virtual hand tools in VR.

title: Wearable Subtitles: Augmenting Spoken Communication with Lightweight Eyewear for All-day Captioning
summary: A lightweight 3D-printed head-worn display (eyewear) with a low-power architecture that shows transcribed speech and sounds as captions all day, helping deaf and hard-of-hearing people follow spoken communication.

title: DeepFisheye: Near-Surface Multi-Finger Tracking Technology Using Fisheye Camera
summary: A near-surface multi-finger tracking technology that uses a fisheye camera at the bottom of a touchscreen and deep learning to estimate 3D fingertip positions, enabling mid-air and finger-aware touchscreen interactions.

title: Haptics with Input: Back-EMF in Linear Resonant Actuators to Enable Touch, Pressure and Environmental Awareness
summary: A technique that uses back-EMF in unmodified linear resonant actuators (LRAs) to sense tap, touch and pressure and environmental contact, letting a haptic actuator also act as an input device.

title: Romeo: A Design Tool for Embedding Transformable Parts in 3D Models to Robotically Augment Default Functionalities
summary: A design tool that lets non-expert users select a part of a 3D model, specify motion points and actions, and automatically generate a 3D-printable embedded robotic arm that augments the object's default functionality.

title: bARefoot: Generating Virtual Materials using Motion Coupled Vibration in Shoes
summary: A prototype haptic shoe that couples vibrotactile impulses to foot motion and pressure to generate virtual material experiences such as compliance for virtual reality and augmented reality, with a tool for designing them.

title: Capacitivo: Contact-Based Object Recognition on Interactive Fabrics using Capacitive Sensing
summary: A contact-based object recognition technique for interactive fabrics using capacitive sensing, recognizing non-metallic objects like food and liquids from their capacitance footprint to trigger context-aware applications.

title: HERMITS: Dynamically Reconfiguring the Interactivity of Self-propelled TUIs with Mechanical Shell Add-ons
summary: A modular interaction architecture for self-propelled tangible user interfaces that uses passive mechanical shell add-ons, dynamically docked by wheeled robots, to reconfigure their shape, motion, light and input.

title: ElastiLinks: Force Feedback between VR Controllers with Dynamic Points of Application of Force
summary: A set of handheld controllers providing resistive force and impact feedback between two virtual reality controllers, with a rotatable track giving a dynamic point of application of force that enhances VR realism.

title: BodyPrinter: Fabricating Circuits Directly on the Skin at Arbitrary Locations Using a Wearable Compact Plotter
summary: A wearable compact plotter that prints flexible conductive circuits and sensors directly onto the skin at arbitrary body locations using skin-safe conductive ink, enabling on-body fabrication.

title: ShARe: Enabling Co-Located Asymmetric Multi-User Interaction for Augmented Reality Head-Mounted Displays
summary: A modified augmented reality head-mounted display with a servo-controlled projector that shows content to outside users on planar surfaces and lets them interact by touch, enabling co-located asymmetric multi-user interaction.

title: HMD Light: Sharing In-VR Experience via Head-Mounted Projector for Asymmetric Interaction
summary: A proof-of-concept head-mounted display with a motor-mounted head-mounted projector that reveals the virtual reality user's experience in the physical environment, supporting asymmetric interaction with co-located external users.

title: AAR: Augmenting a Wearable Augmented Reality Display with an Actuated Head-Mounted Projector
summary: A system and toolkit combining a wearable augmented reality display with an actuated head-mounted projector, calibrated automatically, for expanding field of view, distributing content across surfaces, and sharing virtual content with bystanders.

title: FS-Pad: Video Game Interactions Using Force Feedback Gamepad
summary: A gamepad with a force feedback thumbstick, plus a set of video game interaction themes and a haptic control system, enabling force feedback game interactions and prototyping of haptic gamepads.

title: Taste Display that Reproduces Tastes Measured by a Taste Sensor
summary: A taste display that reproduces tastes measured by taste sensors using iontophoresis on electrolyte gels, with video-editing software and taste effect and equalizer prototypes for editing and adjusting taste information.

title: Pop-up Print: Rapidly 3D Printing Mechanically Reversible Objects in the Folded State
summary: A method for 3D printing objects in a compact folded state with printed hinges, then unfolding them, with an interactive design tool, reducing printing time and support material while allowing reversible folding.

title: Haptic PIVOT: On-Demand Handhelds in VR
summary: A wrist-worn haptic device with a single actuated joint that pivots a haptic handle into and out of the hand on demand, rendering grasping, catching, throwing and forces for virtual reality.

title: E-seed: Shape-Changing Interfaces that Self Drill
summary: A biomimetic platform of self-drilling shape-changing interfaces made from wood veneer that harvest moisture fluctuations to embed sensors and devices into soil, with a parametric design tool and fabrication process.

title: MonoEye: Multimodal Human Motion Capture System Using A Single Ultra-Wide Fisheye Camera
summary: A multimodal human motion capture system using a single chest-mounted ultra-wide fisheye camera and deep neural networks to estimate 3D body pose, head pose and camera pose, capturing the wearer's body and viewport.

title: ZoomWalls: Dynamic Walls that Simulate Haptic Infrastructure for Room-scale VR World
summary: A system of autonomous robotic encounter-type haptic wall-shaped props that coordinate through prediction and dispatch to provide just-in-time haptic feedback of walls and doors for room-scale virtual reality.

title: Polymorphic Blocks: Unifying High-level Specification and Low-level Control for Circuit Board Design
summary: A hardware description language approach to printed circuit board (PCB) design that extends hierarchical block diagrams with polymorphism, generators and electronics modeling, letting designers move from system architecture to layout-ready circuits with low-level control.

title: ElaStick: A Handheld Variable Stiffness Display for Rendering Dynamic Haptic Response of Flexible Object
summary: A handheld variable-stiffness controller for virtual reality that changes the stiffness of elastic tendons along a 2-DOF joint, letting users feel the dynamic haptic response of shaken or swung flexible objects.

title: Programmable Filament: Printed Filaments for Multi-material 3D Printing
summary: A technique for multi-material 3D printing on a commodity single-nozzle FDM printer without hardware modification, by printing and splicing filament segments into a single filament, with design software to generate it.

title: SimuLearn: Fast and Accurate Simulator to Support Morphing Materials Design and Workflows
summary: A data-driven simulation method combining finite element analysis and machine learning to create fast, accurate morphing material simulators, enabling forward, hybrid and inverse design workflows in CAD tools for 4D printed structures.

title: REACH+: Extending the Reachability of Encountered-type Haptics Devices through Dynamic Redirection in VR
summary: A framework for dynamic visuo-haptic redirection that predicts a user's reach target and arrival time and redirects the hand, extending the reachability of encountered-type haptic devices in virtual reality.

title: TelemetRing: A Batteryless and Wireless Ring-shaped Keyboard using Passive Inductive Telemetry
summary: A batteryless and wireless ring-shaped keyboard using passive inductive telemetry that detects finger typing on various surfaces, enabling command and text entry for wearable devices.

title: HandMorph: a Passive Exoskeleton that Miniaturizes Grasp
summary: A passive exoskeleton using mechanical links to transmit finger motion and haptic feedback to a smaller hand, miniaturizing the wearer's grasping range in the real environment, e.g. for evaluating ergonomics of products for children.

title: DefeXtiles: 3D Printing Quasi-Woven Fabric via Under-Extrusion
summary: A rapid, low-cost technique that exploits under-extrusion of filament on unmodified fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printers to print thin, flexible, tulle-like quasi-woven fabrics for personal fabrication, interactive objects and garments.

title: C-Face: Continuously Reconstructing Facial Expressions by Deep Learning Contours of the Face with Ear-mounted Miniature Cameras
summary: An ear-mounted wearable sensing technology using two miniature cameras and deep learning on facial contours to continuously reconstruct facial expressions as feature points, demonstrated in headphones and earphones for emoji input and silent speech.

title: WIKA: A Projected Augmented Reality Workbench for Interactive Kinetic Art
summary: An integrated projected augmented reality workbench with tangible AR plates and a mobile device that supports non-experts in prototyping interactive kinetic art, from sketching and rule programming to simulation and making.

title: LamiFold: Fabricating Objects with Integrated Mechanisms Using a Laser cutter Lamination Workflow
summary: A design and fabrication workflow with mechanical primitives and a CAD plugin for making functional objects with embedded rotary, linear and locking mechanisms by selectively laser cutting and gluing stacks of sheet material.

title: ZebraSense: A Double-sided Textile Touch Sensor for Smart Clothing
summary: A dual-sided woven textile capacitive touch sensor, built with multi-layer weaving, that recognizes multi-touch gestures and distinguishes which side is touched, enabling smart clothing and apparel interfaces.

title: SchemaBoard: Supporting Correct Assembly of Schematic Circuits using Dynamic In-Situ Visualization
summary: A system with an LED-backlit solderless breadboard linked to a schematic on a tablet that lights breadboard rows, helping makers correctly assemble and inspect circuits from schematic diagrams.

title: Sonoflex: Embroidered Speakers Without Permanent Magnets
summary: A thin, lightweight embroidered dynamic speaker made from two stacked flat spiral coils of enameled wire, working without a permanent magnet, for smart textile audio output and near-ultrasound communication.

title: OddEyeCam: A Sensing Technique for Body-Centric Peephole Interaction Using WFoV RGB and NFoV Depth Cameras
summary: A vision-based sensing technique that combines a wide field of view RGB camera and a narrow field of view depth camera on a smartphone to track its 3D location relative to the body for body-centric peephole interaction.

title: CoVR: A Large-Scale Force-Feedback Robotic Interface for Non-Deterministic Scenarios in VR
summary: A large-scale robotic interface, a physical column on a 2D Cartesian ceiling robot with a user intention model, giving strong force-feedback in room-scale VR, including non-deterministic scenarios.

title: GyroSuite: General-Purpose Interactions for Handheld Perspective Corrected Displays
summary: A suite of general-purpose interaction techniques for a two-handed spherical handheld perspective-corrected display, covering distant object selection, scene scaling, menu interaction and continuous parameter control that leverage the display's rotations.

title: poimo: Portable and Inflatable Mobility Devices Customizable for Personal Physical Characteristics
summary: A family of portable inflatable mobility devices made of drop-stitch fabric, with a scan-based interactive design system that customizes personal mobility devices to a user's riding posture and preferences.

title: Kerf-Canceling Mechanisms: Making Laser-Cut Mechanisms Operate across Different Laser Cutters
summary: A set of kerf-canceling mechanisms (bearings, sliders, gear pairs) and a software tool that converts laser-cut models so their mechanisms keep working when fabricated on different laser cutters.

title: Back-Hand-Pose: 3D Hand Pose Estimation for a Wrist-worn Camera via Dorsum Deformation Network
summary: A vision-based, real-time 3D hand pose estimation framework for a wrist-worn camera, using a two-stream convolutional network on deformations of the back of the hand to enable gesture input without instrumenting the fingers.

title: MorphSensor: A 3D Electronic Design Tool for Reforming Sensor Modules
summary: A 3D electronic design tool that lets designers morph existing sensor modules into free-form electronic component arrangements on a prototype's three-dimensional shape while keeping wire connections, with a pre-fabricated PCB footprint fabrication pipeline.

title: Tsugite: Interactive Design and Fabrication of Wood Joints
summary: An interactive system for designing wood joints on a voxel grid with real-time feedback, suggestions and a gallery, and fabricating them with a 3-axis CNC milling machine using a corner-rounding path planning algorithm.

title: Acustico: Surface Tap Detection and Localization using Wrist-based Acoustic TDOA Sensing
summary: A passive acoustic sensing approach using acoustic time differences of arrival (TDOA) that detects and localizes taps on uninstrumented surfaces with a wrist-worn device, fusing surface waves and sound waves.

title: MechanoBeat: Monitoring Interactions with Everyday Objects using 3D Printed Harmonic Oscillators and Ultra-Wideband Radar
summary: A technique that uses electronics-free 3D printed harmonic oscillator tags and an ultra-wideband radar array to monitor interactions with everyday objects, even through walls.

title: LipNotif: Use of Lips as a Non-Contact Tactile Notification Interface Based on Ultrasonic Tactile Presentation
summary: A non-contact tactile notification system that uses airborne ultrasound tactile presentation to the lips, letting people receive directions and emotions without sight, hearing, or hands.

title: SensiCut: Material-Aware Laser Cutting Using Speckle Sensing and Deep Learning
summary: A material sensing platform for laser cutters that uses speckle sensing and deep learning to identify visually similar materials, letting users set correct power and speed settings, avoid hazardous materials, and adjust designs.

title: ModularHMD: A Reconfigurable Mobile Head-Mounted Display Enabling Ad-hoc Peripheral Interactions with the Real World
summary: A reconfigurable mobile head-mounted display concept with removable module devices at the cowl periphery, letting VR users perform ad-hoc peripheral interactions with real-world devices and people without removing the headset.

title: Identifying Contact Fingers on Touch Sensitive Surfaces by Ring-Based Vibratory Communication
