summary: A system that identifies contact fingers on touch sensitive surfaces using ring-worn vibration actuators and vibratory communication, letting wearable interfaces diversify touch interactions with simultaneous multiple fingers.

title: Chemical Haptics: Rendering Haptic Sensations via Topical Stimulants
summary: A new class of haptic devices, a self-contained wearable that pumps topical stimulants through channels open to the skin, rendering tingling, numbing, stinging, warming and cooling sensations for virtual reality.

title: Adroid: Augmenting Hands-on Making with a Collaborative Robot
summary: A system that mounts hand-held fabrication tools on an industrial robot arm, which constrains their motion as virtual jigs and fixtures, with projection augmented reality, for hands-on making.

title: FabHydro: Printing Interactive Hydraulic Devices with an Affordable SLA 3D Printer
summary: A set of rapid, low-cost methods to prototype interactive hydraulic devices with an off-the-shelf SLA 3D printer and flexible photosensitive resin, plus a design space of printable generators, transmitters and actuators.

title: Daedalus in the Dark: Designing for Non-Visual Accessible Construction of Laser-Cut Architecture
summary: A generative design tool, built as an add-in to a commercial modeling system, that produces tactile aids for laser-cut assembly so blind or low vision people can construct laser-cut architecture, informed by co-design heuristics.

title: EIT-kit: An Electrical Impedance Tomography Toolkit for Health and Motion Sensing
summary: A toolkit for designing and fabricating electrical impedance tomography sensing devices for health and motion sensing, with a 3D editor plugin, a sensing motherboard, a microcontroller library and a mobile image reconstruction library.

title: DextrEMS: Increasing Dexterity in Electrical Muscle Stimulation by Combining it with Brakes
summary: A haptic device that combines electrical muscle stimulation (EMS) with mechanical brakes on every finger joint, giving EMS independent finger actuation and stable poses without oscillations, for dexterous force feedback applications.

title: PneuSeries: 3D Shape Forming with Modularized Serial-Connected Inflatables
summary: A shape-changing interface of modularized inflatables connected in series by passive bidirectional check valves, so one pump's sequential push/pull operations program 3D shape forming without a tube and valve per inflatable.

title: HoloBoard: a Large-format Immersive Teaching Board based on pseudo HoloGraphics
summary: A large-format transparent pseudo-holographic teaching board with interaction techniques for lecture-based classes, letting teachers present immersive content, role-play and lecture behind the screen.

title: Per Garment Capture and Synthesis for Real-time Virtual Try-on
summary: A per garment capture and synthesis workflow using an actuated mannequin and a measurement garment with deep image-to-image translation, enabling real-time virtual try-on that reacts to pose, body size and pulling.

title: PocketView: Through-Fabric Information Displays
summary: A study and prototypes of through-fabric information displays that use low resolution bright LED matrix displays to show phone information through the fabric of a pocket, in several wearable form factors.

title: TypeBoard: Identifying Unintentional Touch on Pressure-Sensitive Touchscreen Keyboards
summary: A pressure-sensitive touchscreen keyboard for tablet computers that identifies and ignores unintentional touches such as resting fingers, allowing users to rest fingers and touch type with tactile landmarks.

title: VHP: Vibrotactile Haptics Platform for On-body Applications
summary: An open-source vibrotactile haptics platform with a low-power miniature 12-channel driver board and actuator load sensing, enabling wearable on-body devices such as bracelets, sleeves and phone cases.

title: MotionRing: Creating Illusory Tactile Motion around the Head using 360° Vibrotactile Headbands
summary: A vibrotactile headband that creates illusory apparent tactile motion around the head with a ring of vibration motors, letting users feel directional haptic motion in virtual experiences.

title: X-Rings: A Hand-mounted 360° Shape Display for Grasping in Virtual Reality
summary: A hand-mounted shape display built from stacked motor-driven expanding rings that renders graspable 360° radially-symmetric objects and senses touch and grip force, letting people grasp virtual objects in virtual reality.

title: Midair Balloon Interface: A Soft and Lightweight Midair Object for Proximate Interactions
summary: A soft, lightweight helium-filled balloon propelled in midair by external airborne ultrasound phased arrays and camera tracking, enabling safe-to-collide midair objects for sight-based and touch-based proximate interactions with vibrotactile feedback.

title: STRIVE: String-Based Force Feedback for Automotive Engineering
summary: A participatory design study with automotive engineers that yields requirements for haptic devices in industrial settings and a flexible, wireless string-based force feedback device for virtual reality use cases in automotive engineering.

title: MoiréBoard: A Stable, Accurate and Low-cost Camera Tracking Method
summary: A camera position tracking method using a passive, low-cost two-layer grating visual marker whose moiré effect amplifies camera motion, giving accurate calibration-free 3-DOF tracking for mobile devices and VR.

title: Roadkill: Nesting Laser-Cut Objects for Fast Assembly
summary: A software tool that converts 3D models into 2D cutting plans for laser cutting, with a visual language and subassemblies that place joining plates together to speed up manual assembly in personal fabrication.

title: Altering Perceived Softness of Real Rigid Objects by Restricting Fingerpad Deformation
summary: A wearable haptic device that makes real rigid objects feel softer by restricting fingerpad deformation with a motor-pulled hollow frame, without instrumenting the objects, for VR props, appliances and 3D printed objects.

title: TouchPose: Hand Pose Prediction, Depth Estimation, and Touch Classification from Capacitive Images
summary: A deep learning method that reconstructs 3D hand poses, depth maps and touch classification from the capacitive images of touchscreen digitizers, letting touchscreen devices sense whole-hand configuration for new interactions.

title: OmniFiber: Integrated Fluidic Fiber Actuators for Weaving Movement based Interactions into the ‘Fabric of Everyday Life’
summary: A soft, line-based material system of thin fluidic fiber actuators with integrated stretchable sensors, a design space and fabrication pipeline for weaving movement-based interactions into textiles and wearables.

title: ReflecTrack: Enabling 3D Acoustic Position Tracking Using Commodity Dual-Microphone Smartphones
summary: A method for 3D acoustic position tracking on commodity dual-microphone smartphones that uses a nearby reflective surface and inaudible FMCW signals from a speaker, enabling 3D input, gesture recognition and VR motion tracking.

title: MetaSense: Integrating Sensing Capabilities into Mechanical Metamaterial
summary: A method and 3D editor for integrating continuous deformation sensing into 3D printable mechanical metamaterial structures by turning cell walls into capacitive electrodes, fabricated with multi-material 3D printing for monolithic input devices.

title: Trusscillator: a System for Fabricating Human-Scale Human-Powered Oscillating Devices
summary: A system for personal fabrication that lets non-engineers design and build human-scale, human-powered oscillating devices from welded steel trusses and coil springs, tuning motion range, tempo and effort.

title: Lenticular Objects: 3D Printed Objects with Lenticular Lens Surfaces That Can Change their Appearance Depending on the Viewpoint
summary: A method and design tool for 3D printing lenticular lens surfaces on curved objects with a multi-material 3D printer, so objects show different appearances from different viewpoints.

title: HandyTrak: Recognizing the Holding Hand on a Commodity Smartphone from Body Silhouette Images
summary: A software system that uses body silhouette images from a commodity smartphone's front camera and a deep learning model to continuously recognize which hand holds the phone, enabling adaptive mobile user interfaces.

title: AirConstellations: In-Air Device Formations for Cross-Device Interaction via Multiple Spatially-Aware Armatures
summary: A platform and set of interaction techniques for cross-device computing in which multiple spatially-aware armatures hold tablets and other devices in dynamic in-air formations, letting users reconfigure devices and drive context-sensitive application behaviors.

title: HapticBots: Distributed Encountered-type Haptics for VR with Multiple Shape-changing Mobile Robots
summary: An encountered-type haptic approach for virtual reality that uses multiple tabletop shape-changing mobile robots to render touch points, continuous surfaces and graspable proxy objects on demand.

title: MARS: Nano-Power Battery-free Wireless Interfaces for Touch, Swipe and Speech Input
summary: A prototyping platform of battery-free, nanowatt-power wireless sticker interfaces that use a programmable oscillator and frequency-shifted analog backscatter to sense and communicate touch, swipe and speech input.

title: Bit Whisperer: Enabling Ad-hoc, Short-range, Walk-Up-and-Share Data Transmissions via Surface-restricted Acoustics
summary: An ad-hoc, short-range wireless communication system that sends data between unpaired commodity smartphones co-located on a solid surface using inaudible high-frequency acoustic signals, enabling walk-up-and-share transmissions with good-enough security.

title: WaddleWalls: Room-scale Interactive Partitioning System using a Swarm of Robotic Partitions
summary: A room-scale interactive partitioning system using a swarm of height-adjustable robotic partitions that users arrange with a hand-held controller to reconfigure workspace layouts for privacy and interaction needs.

title: HingeCore: Laser-Cut Foamcore for Fast Assembly
summary: A laser-cut 3D structure made from foamcore using finger hinges for fast, glue-free, sturdy assembly, with software that automatically converts 3D models into 2D cutting plans for laser cutting.

title: ForceSight: Non-Contact Force Sensing with Laser Speckle Imaging
summary: A non-contact force sensing approach using laser speckle imaging that detects minute surface deformations from applied force, enabling force sensing on everyday surfaces without instrumenting them.

title: Prototyping Soft Devices with Interactive Bioplastics
summary: A do-it-yourself approach for making conductive bioplastic sheets, pastes and foams from bio-based materials, letting makers prototype soft interactive devices, circuits and sensors that can be re-melted, re-used or composted.

title: Project Primrose: Reflective Light-Diffuser Modules for Non-Emissive Flexible Display Systems
summary: Reflective light-diffuser modules built from reflective-backed polymer-dispersed liquid crystal (PDLC) and flexible drive circuitry, enabling low-power non-emissive flexible textile displays such as a canvas and a handbag.

title: Sketched Reality: Sketching Bi-Directional Interactions Between Virtual and Physical Worlds with AR and Actuated Tangible UI
summary: An approach combining augmented reality sketching and actuated tangible user interfaces so virtual sketches and physical robots affect each other, letting people sketch physical-virtual interactions.

title: TangibleGrid: Tangible Web Layout Design for Blind Users
summary: A tangible user interface device with shape-changing brackets and a sensing baseboard that lets blind users understand and design web page layouts with real-time tangible and audio feedback.

title: Integrating Living Organisms in Devices to Implement Care-based Interactions
summary: A concept and smartwatch prototype that embeds a living organism, a slime mold acting as a living wire, as a functional component of a device so users provide care for it.

title: DigituSync: A Dual-User Passive Exoskeleton Glove That Adaptively Shares Hand Gestures
summary: A passive exoskeleton glove with four-bar linkages and variable-length linkages that physically links two users' hands to share finger movements and force, with adjustable force transmission, for skill transfer.

title: Look over there! Investigating Saliency Modulation for Visual Guidance with Augmented Reality Glasses
summary: A technique and prototypes for saliency modulation of the real world with optical see-through augmented reality glasses, guiding users' gaze to objects without graphical overlays such as outlines and arrows.

title: DiscoBand: Multiview Depth-Sensing Smartwatch Strap for Hand, Body and Environment Tracking
summary: A smartwatch strap with distributed ultra-small depth sensors imaging the hand from multiple views and the body outward, enabling arm and hand pose tracking plus environment sensing.

title: Prolonging VR Haptic Experiences by Harvesting Kinetic Energy from the User
summary: A technical approach to batteryless wearable haptics that harvests the user's kinetic energy into supercapacitors and adapts the virtual reality experience to conceal the resistance, prolonging VR haptic feedback.

title: Kinergy: Creating 3D Printable Motion using Embedded Kinetic Energy
summary: An interactive design tool that embeds parameterizable 3D printable springs, compliant locks and transmission mechanisms into 3D models to create self-propelled motion that is printed in place without assembly.

title: iWood: Makeable Vibration Sensor for Interactive Plywood
summary: A makeable interactive plywood material that senses vibration through the triboelectric effect, letting furniture and artifacts made with ordinary woodworking operations detect user gestures and activities.

title: AirLogic: Embedding Pneumatic Computation and I/O in 3D Models to Fabricate Electronics-Free Interactive Objects
summary: A technique for 3D printing electronics-free interactive objects by embedding pneumatic input, logic and output widgets, based on fluerics, that compute on airflow and respond with visible, audible or haptic output.

title: HapTag: A Compact Actuator for Rendering Push-Button Tactility on Soft Surfaces
summary: A thin, flexible hydraulically amplified electroactive actuator with an integrated pressure sensing layer that renders configurable push-button tactility on soft surfaces such as cloth, leather and rubber.

title: MagneShape: A Non-electrical Pin-Based Shape-Changing Display
summary: A simple pin-based shape-changing display that moves magnetic pins with a patterned magnetic sheet and no electronic elements, with design tools and low-cost pin fabrication methods for prototyping.

title: Reconfigurable Elastic Metamaterials
summary: A reconfigurable elastic metamaterial of generic spring and damper cells that end users repeatedly configure with 3D printed layers and an interactive editor, to augment objects with locally tunable elasticity.

title: MetamorphX: An Ungrounded 3-DoF Moment Display that Changes its Physical Properties through Rotational Impedance Control
summary: An ungrounded 3-DoF moment display built from four control moment gyroscopes that uses rotational impedance control to change the perceived inertia and viscosity of a wielded object in virtual reality.

title: Fibercuit: Prototyping High-Resolution Flexible and Kirigami Circuits with a Fiber Laser Engraver
summary: A set of rapid prototyping techniques using a fiber laser engraver to cut, laser solder and laser form copper-based composites into high-resolution flexible and kirigami circuits, with a design interface.

title: DeltaPen: A Device with Integrated High-Precision Translation and Rotation Sensing on Passive Surfaces
summary: A pen device integrating two lens-less optical flow sensors, an inertial sensor, a pressure sensor and a haptic actuator to sense precise translation, rotation and tilt on passive, uninstrumented surfaces without external tracking.

title: PassengXR: A Low Cost Platform for Any-Car, Multi-User, Motion-Based Passenger XR Experiences
summary: An open-source, low-cost toolkit and reference hardware for creating multi-user passenger XR experiences in any car by broadcasting vehicle telemetry to standalone headsets, with headset alignment correction and telemetry recording and playback.

title: NFCStack: Identifiable Physical Building Blocks that Support Concurrent Construction and Frictionless Interaction
summary: A physical building block system based on near-field communication (NFC) with passive identifiable bricks, boxes and adapters on a portable station, supporting concurrent stacking, rich-ID construction and frictionless tangible interaction.

title: EtherPose: Continuous Hand Pose Tracking with Wrist-Worn Antenna Impedance Characteristic Sensing
summary: A wrist-worn band that measures the swept-frequency impedance characteristic of two antennas with compact vector network analyzers and uses machine learning to track continuous 3D hand pose, wrist angle and micro-gestures.

title: Muscle Synergies Learning with Electrical Muscle Stimulation for Playing the Piano
summary: A system using electrical muscle stimulation (EMS) of the deltoid muscle to teach beginners better muscle synergies for playing scales evenly on the piano with the thumb-under method.

title: MechARspace: An Authoring System Enabling Bidirectional Binding of Augmented Reality with Toys in Real-time
summary: An immersive authoring system with a plug-and-play modular IoT toolkit that lets users create bidirectional Augmented Reality interactions with toys through programming by demonstration and visual programming.

title: interiqr: Unobtrusive Edible Tags using Food 3D Printing
summary: A method that uses the infill structure of food 3D printing to embed hidden edible tags inside food, decoded with backlight illumination and simple image processing.

title: ShrinkCells: Localized and Sequential Shape-Changing Actuation of 3D-Printed Objects via Selective Heating
summary: A set of 3D-printed shape-changing actuators that use localized resistive heating of conductive PLA to shrink or bend a Shape Memory Polymer, with a fuse mechanism for sequential actuation from a single power supply.

title: Computational Design of Active Kinesthetic Garments
summary: A computational pipeline using on-body topology optimization to automatically design connecting structures between electrostatic clutches, producing active kinesthetic garments that resist chosen body motions on demand for force-feedback.

title: TipTrap: A Co-located Direct Manipulation Technique for Acoustically Levitated Content.
summary: A co-located direct manipulation technique for acoustically levitated content that uses ultrasound reflections on the fingertip and a closed-loop system to select, manipulate and release levitated particles with bare hands.

title: ELAXO : Rendering Versatile Resistive Force Feedback for Fingers Grasping and Twisting
summary: A wearable exoskeleton device for virtual reality that renders continuous resistive force and rotational resistive force, with or without resilience, so fingers can feel grasping and twisting of virtual objects.

title: Integrating Real-World Distractions into Virtual Reality
summary: An approach that integrates distracting real-world stimuli such as sounds, wind and temperature shifts into the virtual reality experience through a headset-mounted sensing module, to improve presence.

title: ARDW: An Augmented Reality Workbench for Printed Circuit Board Debugging
summary: An augmented reality workbench that uses a projector, tracked test probes and a connected multimeter to cross-link the physical printed circuit board with its schematic and layout files for debugging.

title: Seeing our Blind Spots: Smart Glasses-based Simulation to Increase Design Students’ Awareness of Visual Impairment
summary: Optical see-through smart glasses with transparent LCD lenses and real-time eye tracking that simulate central and peripheral vision loss, to increase design students' awareness of visual impairment.

title: SenSequins: Smart Textile Using 3D Printed Conductive Sequins
summary: A digital fabrication method and design software for smart textiles that uses 3D printed conductive sequins, sewn with a computerized embroidery machine, to realize customizable circuits and sensing such as body movement.

title: spaceR: Knitting Ready-Made, Tactile, and Highly Responsive Spacer-Fabric Force Sensors for Continuous Input
summary: A resistive force sensor design, knit ready-made as a spacer fabric on a weft knitting machine, that gives tactile, highly responsive continuous input for textile interfaces such as buttons and controllers.

title: Flaticulation: Laser Cutting Joints with Articulated Angles
summary: A method for laser cutting joints with T-patterns that clutch two cut-in-place boards at designated articulated angles, enabling easy assembly of unfolded 3D polygonal models and detent mechanisms in personal fabrication.

title: Mixels: Fabricating Interfaces using Programmable Magnetic Pixels
summary: A design and fabrication pipeline for interfaces made of programmable magnetic pixels, using an electromagnetic printhead on a 3-axis CNC machine and a user interface to specify selectively attractive, repulsive or agnostic behavior.

title: Flexel: A Modular Floor Interface for Room-Scale Tactile Sensing
summary: A modular floor interface with sparse load sensors for room-scale tactile sensing, letting rooms be paved with modules to infer touch locations, track footprints, recognize foot gestures and localize objects.

title: MuscleRehab: Improving Unsupervised Physical Rehabilitation by Monitoring and Visualizing Muscle Engagement
summary: A rehabilitation system combining wearable electrical impedance tomography and optical motion tracking to monitor and visualize muscle engagement on a virtual avatar, improving unsupervised physical rehabilitation and post-rehabilitation evaluation.

title: X-Bridges: Designing Tunable Bridges to Enrich 3D Printed Objects' Deformation and Stiffness
summary: An end-to-end workflow and design tool for novice users to design tunable bridges in fused deposition modeling (FDM) prints, enriching 3D printed objects with deformation primitives and loose, elastic or stable stiffness.

title: Sustainflatable: Harvesting, Storing and Utilizing Ambient Energy for Pneumatic Morphing Interfaces
summary: A self-sustaining, electronic-free pneumatic system with non-electric pumps, storage units and valves that harvests ambient energy into compressed air for pneumatic morphing interfaces, plus a design tool for building it.

title: VoxelHap: A Toolkit for Constructing Proxies Providing Tactile and Kinesthetic Haptic Feedback in Virtual Reality
summary: A block-based construction toolkit for building reconfigurable physical proxies with tactile and kinesthetic haptic feedback in virtual reality, combining functional blocks, printed plates and VR illusion techniques.

title: SPEERLoom: An Open-Source Loom Kit for Interdisciplinary Engagement in Math, Engineering, and Textiles
summary: An open-source robotic Jacquard loom kit with individually actuated and tensioned warp yarns, supporting interdisciplinary learning of mathematics, engineering and textiles in collegiate classrooms.

title: An Adaptable Workflow for Manual-Computational Ceramic Surface Ornamentation
summary: An interactive manual-computational workflow for procedurally designing patterns on 3D vessel models and unrolling them into fabricated stencils, letting craftspeople ornament ceramic surfaces with existing manual techniques.

title: HoloBots: Augmenting Holographic Telepresence with Mobile Robots for Tangible Remote Collaboration in Mixed Reality
summary: A mixed reality remote collaboration system that synchronizes holographic telepresence with tabletop mobile robots, letting remote users physically touch, grasp and manipulate objects in a local environment.

title: Neighbor-Environment Observer: An Intelligent Agent for Immersive Working Companionship
summary: An intelligent agent framework that jointly observes physical and virtual environments with non-invasive sensors and acts through physical and virtual embodiments, helping people handle disruptions while immersed in virtual reality.

title: Skinergy: Machine-Embroidered Silicone-Textile Composites as On-Skin Self-Powered Input Sensors
summary: Self-powered on-skin input sensors, machine-embroidered silicone-textile composites based on triboelectric nanogenerators (TENG), enabling touch detection, contact localization and gesture recognition without external power for the sensor.

title: BrushLens: Hardware Interaction Proxies for Accessible Touchscreen Interface Actuation
summary: A hardware interaction proxy, a phone case with an array of touchscreen actuators, that locates itself on inaccessible touchscreens and actuates them on behalf of visually and motor impaired users through their accessible smartphone interface.

title: FibeRobo: Fabricating 4D Fiber Interfaces by Continuous Drawing of Temperature Tunable Liquid Crystal Elastomers
summary: A thermally-actuated liquid crystal elastomer (LCE) fiber and a continuous UV fiber drawing process that produces long fibers compatible with weaving, embroidery and knitting machines, enabling shape-changing, fiber-based textile interfaces.

title: RadarFoot: Fine-grain Ground Surface Context Awareness for Smart Shoes
summary: A shoe-embedded mmWave radar sensing approach with classification models that recognize ground surface types and gait motion while walking, giving smart shoes fine-grain ground surface context awareness.

title: SleeveIO: Modular and Reconfigurable Platform for Multimodal Wearable Haptic Feedback Interactions
summary: A modular and reconfigurable hardware platform for rapid prototyping of multimodal wearable haptic feedback, with knitted substrates and a magnetic attachment mechanism for combining different types of haptic actuator modules.

title: Constraint-Driven Robotic Surfaces, At Human-Scale
summary: A shape-changing robotic surface at human scale that uses small servo-driven constraints on hinged cell columns, with powerful actuation at the edges, to form reconfigurable architectural furniture.

title: PressurePick: Muscle Tension Estimation for Guitar Players Using Unobtrusive Pressure Sensing
summary: A wearable guitar pick device with unobtrusive pressure sensing, plus an analysis of pressure patterns, that estimates a guitar player's muscle tension while practicing songs.

title: VRoxy: Wide-Area Collaboration From an Office Using a VR-Driven Robotic Proxy
summary: A VR-driven robotic proxy system that maps a user's small movements in a VR headset space to a mobile robot in a larger remote space, supporting navigation and remote collaboration with non-verbal cues.

title: CubeSense++: Smart Environment Sensing with Interaction-Powered Corner Reflector Mechanisms
summary: A set of battery-free 3D printed corner reflector and gear mechanisms that encode user interactions with everyday objects into millimeter wave radar responses for smart environment sensing of fine-grained activity information.

title: SwarmFidget: Exploring Programmable Actuated Fidgeting with Swarm Robots
summary: A concept of programmable actuated fidgeting, with a design space and exploratory study, in which a swarm of tabletop robots provides customizable interactive fidgeting through touch, gesture and programmable behaviors.

title: ThermalRouter: Enabling Users to Design Thermally-Sound Devices
summary: A CAD plugin that automatically converts regions of a 3D model into thermally-conductive heat channels, simulating many variations, so users can design thermally-sound 3D printed and soft devices.

title: Computational Design of Personalized Wearable Robotic Limbs
summary: A computational design approach for rapid prototyping of personalized wearable robotic limbs that captures a user's body and motion and generates fabricable structures, letting non-roboticists design them.

title: Structured Light Speckle: Joint Ego-Centric Depth Estimation and Low-Latency Contact Detection via Remote Vibrometry
summary: A sensing method that fuses structured laser light depth estimation with laser speckle remote vibrometry, letting a head-mounted display discover physical surfaces and detect touch on them egocentrically for Virtual Reality.

title: Reprogrammable Digital Metamaterials for Interactive Devices
summary: Digital mechanical metamaterials built from bistable-spring cells with recharging and reprogrammable logic functions after fabrication, enabling passive yet interactive devices such as haptic floors and displays.

title: BrightMarker: 3D Printed Fluorescent Markers for Object Tracking
summary: A fabrication method that uses near-infrared fluorescent filaments to embed invisible, easily trackable markers in 3D printed color objects, with detection hardware and software for real-time object tracking.

title: Telextiles: End-to-end Remote Transmission of Fabric Tactile Sensation
summary: An interface that remotely transmits the tactile sensation of textiles using a hand-held tactile sensor, a latent space learned by contrastive self-supervised learning, and a roller-type actuator presenting the closest textile sample.

title: MagKnitic: Machine-knitted Passive and Interactive Haptic Textiles with Integrated Binary Sensing
summary: A design and fabrication pipeline using digital machine knitting to integrate passive force feedback and binary sensing into textiles, letting people make soft passive haptic interfaces with parametric design templates.

title: Parametric Haptics: Versatile Geometry-based Tactile Feedback Devices
summary: A technique for customizable, 3D-printed wearable tactile feedback patches whose tactor geometry encodes the sensation, driven by a generic motorized actuation interface, letting designers create haptic feedback for VR, objects and notifications.

title: BioWeave: Weaving Thread-Based Sweat-Sensing On-Skin Interfaces
summary: A woven, thread-based sweat-sensing on-skin interface, with fabrication approaches for colorimetric and electrochemical sensing threads and a design space of woven structures and patterns for wearable textiles on diverse body locations.

title: Biohybrid Devices: Prototyping Interactive Devices with Growable Materials
summary: A fabrication framework and set of techniques for embedding electronics in bacterial cellulose across its growth life cycle, enabling growable, interactive biohybrid devices for tangible, wearable and shape-changing interfaces.

title: WavoID: Robust and Secure Multi-modal User Identification via mmWave-voice Mechanism
summary: A multi-modal user identification system that fuses millimeter wave (mmWave) sensed vocal vibration with microphone-recorded voice, with bimodal liveness detection, for robust and secure identification in voice-controlled devices.

title: Semantic Hearing: Programming Acoustic Scenes with Binaural Hearables
summary: A capability for binaural hearable devices, built on a real-time neural network for binaural target sound extraction, that lets users focus on or block specific sound classes while preserving spatial cues.

title: TacNote: Tactile and Audio Note-Taking for Non-Visual Access
summary: A mobile app and modified 3D printing pen system that lets blind and visually impaired people create tactile graphics, annotate everyday objects, and read them with finger-pointing and audio feedback for note-taking.

title: ShadowTouch: Enabling Free-Form Touch-Based Hand-to-Surface Interaction with Wrist-Mounted Illuminant by Shadow Projection
summary: A sensing method that mounts a light source on the wrist to cast finger shadows on a surface, with a CNN-based algorithm recognizing touch states of independent fingers for hand-to-surface interaction in mixed reality.

title: Turn-It-Up: Rendering Resistance for Knobs in Virtual Reality through Undetectable Pseudo-Haptics
summary: A pseudo-haptic technique for virtual reality that slows virtual rotations of a physical proxy knob with undetectable control-display gains to convey physical resistance, with detection thresholds and a model of perceived resistance.

title: KnitScript: A Domain-Specific Scripting Language for Advanced Machine Knitting
summary: A domain-specific scripting language for machine knitting, with a virtual model of the knitting machine, that lets programmers write parameterized, computationally driven knitting designs instead of low-level machine operations.

title: Robust Finger Interactions with COTS Smartwatches via Unsupervised Siamese Adaptation
summary: A system for robust finger interactions on commercial off-the-shelf smartwatches using a single IMU sensor and unsupervised Siamese adversarial learning that adapts to deployment variations without user calibration.

title: Double-Sided Tactile Interactions for Grasping in Virtual Reality
summary: A thin, flexible double-sided electrotactile device and a concept of double-sided tactile interactions that let people feel objects held, and moving, between pinched fingers in virtual reality.

title: Dynamic Toolchains: Software Infrastructure for Digital Fabrication Workflows
summary: Software infrastructure of browser-based dataflow programs with event-driven, interactive modules, plus a module library and development framework, that supports developing digital fabrication workflows across plotters, knitting, milling, embroidery and 3D printing.

title: 3D Printing Magnetophoretic Displays
summary: A pipeline using a modified FDM 3D printer with a syringe injector and a 3D editor to print interactive, always-on magnetophoretic displays whose appearance can be edited with magnets after printing.

title: Pantœnna: Mouth pose estimation for ar/vr headsets using low-profile antenna and impedance characteristic sensing
summary: A technique for estimating mouth pose in VR/AR headsets using a low-profile antenna integrated in the headset and antenna impedance characteristic sensing, without cameras or audio, enabling tracking of facial expressions and speech.

title: FeetThrough: Electrotactile Foot Interface that Preserves Real-World Sensations
summary: A thin, flexible electrotactile foot interface with a 60-electrode array that gives haptic feedback on the sole while letting users still feel the real terrain under their feet, for VR and AR.

title: Stereoscopic Viewing and Monoscopic Touching: Selecting Distant Objects in VR Through a Mobile Device
summary: A VR interaction technique that uses a smartphone as a transparent window and switches between stereoscopic viewing and monoscopic touching modes to avoid binocular parallax when selecting distant objects.

title: EmTex: Prototyping Textile-Based Interfaces through An Embroidered Construction Kit
summary: A construction kit of machine-embroidered textile sensors, actuators and connectors, with a visual programming tool, that lets designers and makers prototype smart textile interfaces without expert knowledge.

title: Taste Retargeting via Chemical Taste Modulators
summary: A technique that selectively alters the basic tastes of real foods by delivering chemical taste modulators to the mouth before eating, letting a single food prop stand in for many virtual foods in virtual reality.

title: AirTied: Automatic Personal Fabrication of Truss Structures
summary: A device and editor for personal fabrication that automatically builds large inflatable truss structures by unrolling a plastic tube and tying nodes into it, without scaffolding or pre-made building blocks.

title: SmartPoser: Arm Pose Estimation with a Smartphone and Smartwatch Using UWB and IMU Data
summary: A software-only technique that fuses ultra-wideband distance and inertial data from an off-the-shelf smartphone and smartwatch to track a wearer's arm pose in real time on mobile devices.

title: TactTongue: Prototyping ElectroTactile Stimulations on the Tongue
summary: An oral interface and prototyping platform with a design tool that renders electrotactile stimulations and some tastes on the tongue, and senses touch input, for accessibility, surgery and extended reality.
